## out-flat/.github/hooks/aidd-context.hooks.json
{
  "version": 1,
  "hooks": {
    "SessionStart": [
      {
        "type": "command",
        "command": "node ./.github/hooks/aidd-context/memory.cjs hook",
        "timeout": 5
      }
    ],
    "PostToolUse": [
      {
        "type": "command",
        "command": "node ./.github/hooks/aidd-context/memory.cjs hook",
        "matcher": "Write|Edit|MultiEdit|Bash|Shell|bash|powershell",
        "timeout": 5
      }
    ]
  }
}

  "hooks": {

        "timeout": 10
      },
      {
        "type": "command",
        "command": "node ./.github/hooks/aidd-telemetry/catch-up.cjs",
        "timeout": 120

    ],
    "UserPromptSubmit": [
      {
        "type": "command",
        "command": "node ./.github/hooks/aidd-telemetry/prompt-gate.cjs",
        "timeout": 30
      }
    ]
  }
}
